_lore: Canon (Ilvermorny writing, via summaries): Violetta Beauvais's core, with an affinity for Dark magic. Gameplay: more Dark Arts power (authored +10%, plus its dark affinity), the wand corrupts faster, and it warms only to a Dark caster: its ordinary bond growth is half, while each Dark cast deepens the bond by more than an ordinary cast would.
_making_canon: No canon wand pairs this core; every wood is neutral.
_pulse_canon: rougarou hair: no canon wand notes; restless, as the dark creature it comes from
